claim: AMP style reward can be learned from a few seconds of motion capture data (German Shepherd) and produces energy-efficient locomotion with natural gait transitions on real quadrupedal hardware.
stance_target: Minimal AMP demo dataset sufficiency for locomotion
scope_conditions: Quadrupedal robot, sim-to-real transfer, IROS 2022 best paper finalist
quoted_support: 'an effective style reward can be learned from a few seconds of motion capture data gathered from a German Shepherd and leads to energy-efficient locomotion strategies with natural gait transitions'

claim: Training budget for Escontrela et al. AMP quadruped is not reported on the project page — the paper PDF must be consulted for num_envs, step counts, wall-clock, and GPU details.
quoted_support: Project page contains only qualitative description and video demonstrations; no training configuration table or step budget is presented.
